verdict.rationale: The only data-retrieval capability documented is downloading a free image of each processed annual report, plus ordering certified copies; separately, entities can dissolve or withdraw, which covers the 'leave' part. There is no documented bulk export of an entity's records, and no structured or open-format output. Missing for 10: bulk export of all entity data, open or machine-readable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), and any independent or hands-on confirmation of the download feature.
